candidates.explanation: AutoCompound._withdrawBalanceInternal is a must-succeed withdraw settlement/cleanup flow that pushes a untrusted token parameter via safetransfer( to a counterparty with NO containment (no try/catch, pull-payment, or allowlist). A hostile token (revert / blacklist / false-return / reentrancy) blocks the cleanup, permanently locking assets or denying service to another user (reNFT H-01 / #64 / #605 class).
candidates.false_positive_controls: five-signal (cleanup-verb fn + must-succeed token push + attacker/order-sourced token + missing containment + counterparty recipient); caller-own-asset / try-catch / pull-payment / allowlist / trusted-asset suppressed; admin-only downgraded
